# AB Digital Consultancy

> A Bengaluru web partner for small and medium businesses across India: website design and development, hosting and domains, content updates, SEO, maintenance, digital marketing support, print materials, and ISO certification consulting.

- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, working with businesses anywhere in India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10am to 7pm
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 90521 42231
- Email: hello@abdigitalconsultancy.in
- Website packages start at ₹12,000 to build and ₹5,000 a year to keep running
- Clients own their domain, content and code, with no lock-in and no exit fee

Each page below is also available as Markdown: request it with an `Accept: text/markdown` header, or open the `.md` link directly.
